prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 8 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, Day, soft daylight through sheer curtains.
Image 1: the character sheet of Su Yaqing (27)
Image 2: the location INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 3: the location INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 4: the location INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 6: the location INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 7: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 8: the prop phone; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Su Yaqing lounges on the cream bouclé sofa in the middle of the room. The sofa's back is to the curtained windows and it faces the TV wall. She wears the lilac camisole and the white mini skirt, barefoot, and holds the phone up in one hand on a video call. The round travertine coffee table stands in front of the sofa, holding flowers and an empty tablet stand. The brass floor lamp stands beside the sofa. The brass-framed kitchen doorway on the right wall is empty. Camera side: in front of the sofa, on the TV wall side, facing the sofa and the windows.
Panel 1: Wide shot, fast push in, eye level, from the TV wall facing the sofa and the windows. The bright penthouse living room. Su Yaqing lounges on the cream sofa with her legs tucked up, holding the phone at arm's length and smiling at the call.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the coffee table side facing the sofa. Su Yaqing's eyebrows rise and a delighted grin spreads across her face as she looks at the phone screen.
Panel 3: Medium shot, locked-off camera, high angle, from the TV wall side. Su Yaqing sits up straight on the sofa and pulls the phone closer to her face.
Panel 4: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the coffee table side. Su Yaqing blinks in amused disbelief and cocks her head.
Panel 5: Medium shot, slow pull out, eye level, from the TV wall facing the sofa. Su Yaqing's jaw drops, and she clutches a silk cushion to her chest while staring at the phone.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, handheld, low angle, from the coffee table side. Su Yaqing bursts out laughing, flops back against the cushions and waves her free hand at the phone.
Panel 7: Close-up insert, tilt down following the phone, high angle, over the travertine coffee table. Su Yaqing's hand props the phone upright in the tablet stand on the coffee table beside the flowers.
Panel 8: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the TV wall facing the sofa. Su Yaqing sits back on the sofa facing the phone on the stand, rolls her eyes playfully and nods along.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
